'''Felucian Chieftains''' were a high-ranking position held by members of the [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Overview==
Chieftains were a part of the leadership cast of the [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Massive and commanding, they inspired awe and fear in their followers. Though slower than normal warriors, they were much hardier thanks to their dense flesh. They were also incredibly strong, and trained from an early age to wield a ceremonial staff in combat. They could channel the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] through their staff, drawing on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia's]] web of living energy to create powerful blasts of energy. Many chieftains also carried sturdy shields that were constructed using the Force.<ref name=":0">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed Databank'']]</ref> 

==History==
When [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] exiled herself to Felucia, she began to train the Felucians and their Chieftains to hone their Force abilities and push back the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]]. She was accepted as a respected Chieftain of multiple tribes.<ref name=":0" /> 

After [[Galen Marek]] [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|killed]] Master Ti, the Felucian's lost their guiding light and fell to the Dark side. Among the Felucians, the Chieftains developed the most dramatically under the influence of evil. Though they were originally trained to lead and defend their people, they came to only care about killing. They rampaged across the planet unchecked, blindly attacking anything they encountered.<ref name=":0" /> Two corrupted Chieftains fought against Galen Marek and attempted to kill him during his [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|second visit]] to Felucia.<ref>[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Chieftain does not feature in the PS2 version of the game.
